prompt: A simple, professional monochrome physics exam diagram on a pure white #FFFFFF background. The image shows two horizontal cylindrical wires, one positioned above the other. The top wire is a simple cylinder outline. The bottom wire is another cylinder outline that is visibly longer and thicker than the top one. Label 'X' is placed just to the left of the top wire, with no leader line. Label 'Y' is placed just to the left of the bottom wire, with no leader line. The cylinders are drawn as simple 2D outlines with elliptical ends to indicate their cylindrical shape. No extra arrows, no dimensions, no shading, and no background details. The style must be clean, minimal black line art with Times New Roman-like serif font for the labels.
negative_prompt: Pure white background only; no grey paper, gradient, or texture. No extra labels. No overlap. No sans-serif fonts. No decorative shading. No photorealism. No colour unless explicitly requested. No exact answer-bearing measurements. No clutter. No malformed symbols. Do not place objects in the wrong support/location relationship. No medium label pointing at objects inside the medium. No fluid label terminating on a sphere, wall, or meniscus. No unrequested arrows, force labels, field symbols, construction arcs, or explanatory overlays.

must_show_relations: Wire X is above Wire Y
Wire Y is visibly longer and thicker than Wire X
relative_size_constraints: Wire Y must be drawn longer than Wire X
Wire Y must be drawn with a larger diameter (thicker) than Wire X

hard_constraints: background must be pure white #FFFFFF with no grey fill or gradient
no unrequested arrows, force labels, field symbols, or construction arcs
Wire Y must appear visibly longer and thicker than Wire X
